actions.name: Use
actions.area: caster and allies within a 30-ft.-radius centered on you

description.summary: The caster emulates a cie’th chonchon’s ability to emit a refreshing hum that closes the wounds of its fellows
description.value: The caster emulates a cie’th chonchon’s ability to emit a refreshing hum that closes the wounds of its fellows. All allies (including the caster) within a 30-ft.-radius are healed for 3d6 points of damage, are cured of the Poison status effect, and no longer suffer fatigue. Exhausted allies within the radius are instead fatigued. Learned From cie’th chonchon, blue dragon family, and cie’th penanggalan
